apps.versionDescription:
Plezy v2.26.2 (Upstream Sync + iOS 27 External Display & Custom Fixes)

Included Updates:
- PiP playback now stops at the end when auto-play next is off
- Watch Together guests can skip credits that run to the end of the file
- TV D-pad navigation reaches the profile menu from an empty Home screen
- Official iOS 27 SDK external-display scene accessory registration (#2471)
- Enhanced external display lock screen background playback and auto-pause on disconnect (#2729)
- Custom Jellyfin STRM direct-play (#2631)
- Custom DTS-HD audio fallback & MPV recovery (#2644)
- Custom ExoPlayer buffer stall prevention (#2653)
- Custom Jellyfin active audio track mapping (#2655)
apps.localizedDescription: Plezy is a modern, lightweight media player client for Plex and Jellyfin servers, featuring native hardware decoding, Direct Play, and smooth playback.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: This app needs to connect to your media servers on your local network.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Plezy uses location access when iOS requires it to detect your local network and connect to your media servers.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Plezy needs photo library access so you can choose images to upload as media artwork.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera is used to scan QR codes for Companion Remote pairing.

versions.localizedDescription: Release 2.26.2 with upstream main fixes (PiP playback end, Watch Together credit skip, TV empty-home D-pad profile navigation) plus all custom fixes.

Release 2.26.1 with upstream main updates (iOS 27 external-display scene accessory, Fire TV HDR10+/DV filter, 50/60Hz refresh rate doubling, purgeable download storage) plus iOS 27 lock-screen playback & auto-pause (#2729), Jellyfin STRM direct-play (#2631), DTS-HD fallback (#2644), ExoPlayer buffer stall prevention (#2653), and audio track mapping (#2655).

Release 2.26.0 with Upstream 2.26.0 features (32-bit Android optimization, library shuffle, genres tab, zoom memory, audio passthrough fixes) plus iOS 27 external-display playback (#2729), Jellyfin STRM playback (#2631), DTS-HD fallback (#2644), ExoPlayer buffer stall prevention (#2653), and audio track mapping (#2655).
Release 2.25.1 with iOS 27 external-display playback restoration (#2729), custom Jellyfin STRM playback, DTS-HD audio fallback, buffer stall prevention, and track selection fixes.
